title: Chief-of-Staff: working chat, memory, container and EC2 with human product reviews
description: Inert revision with five working-product reviews. Each milestone requires repository evidence, an operator-confirmed deployed review environment and real live checks before customer acceptance releases dependent work. Existing foundation receipts and implementation are reused. Concurrency remains five; no deployment authority or spend is added.
